containerDefinitions.name: infinityai-engine-d
command: pip install fastapi uvicorn requests pydantic openai anthropic && python -c "from fastapi import FastAPI; import uvicorn; app = FastAPI(); @app.get('/health'); def health(): return {'status': 'healthy', 'engine': 'ai_chatbot', 'version': '2.0.0', 'features': ['voice_commands', 'trading_assistant', 'nlp_processing']}; @app.get('/engine-d/health'); def engine_health(): return {'status': 'healthy', 'engine': 'ai_chatbot', 'version': '2.0.0', 'features': ['voice_commands', 'trading_assistant', 'nlp_processing']}; @app.post('/engine-d/chat'); def chat(message: dict): return {'response': 'Hello! I am your AI trading assistant. How can I help you today?', 'engine': 'ai_chatbot'}; uvicorn.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8004)"
